How it works

From a few lines of text to a finished video

  1. 1

    Write the script

    Paste a plain conversation ("Developer: Why is my bill so high?") and the studio stages it for you. Or write a full script with gestures, sounds and camera moves, or start from an example.

  2. 2

    Check it

    The checker reads every line before anything renders and points at problems: an unknown gesture, a face out of frame, text too close to the edge.

  3. 3

    Render on your GPU

    Voices are made in your browser, the scene is timed to them, and your graphics chip draws every frame. Music and effects are mixed in.

  4. 4

    Download the MP4

    Watch it right on the page, then save a standard H.264 video with AAC audio, ready for YouTube, Shorts or a slide deck.

coffee-break.txtOpen in the studio
# Coffee Break
format: landscape-1080p
music: procedural:light-comedy

## SCENE living-room: Coffee break
camera: wide on juno, cloud, push-in 0.12
cast: juno @1,-0.55 facing -55; cloud @-0.3,-0.3 facing juno
ambience: room-tone
[juno looks around for 1.2]
[pause 1.2]
JUNO (worried): Did you just switch off production?
[camera: close-up on cloud from -30]
CLOUD (cheerful, shrugs): It looked tired.
[cut to medium on juno from 10]
[juno facepalms] [sfx: boing]
[pause 1.4]
[fade out 0.6]

Script in, video out

Fifteen lines become a nine-second scene

No timeline, no keyframes. The script says what happens; the studio works out the timing, walks, gestures, lip sync, lighting and camera framing, the same way every time.

This exact script, rendered in a browser tab with the built-in voices.

Features

A small animation studio that lives in a tab

Everything a short animated video needs, from voices to the final file, without leaving the page.

Your GPU does the drawing

Your graphics chip draws every frame and your browser makes the video file. No render farm, no queue, no upload.

Voices made in your browser

Eight built-in voices run on your machine. They download once (about 31 MB) and load in about a second after that.

Same script, same video

Characters are built from maths, not generated pictures, so they look the same in every shot and every episode.

A camera that frames itself

Ask for a wide, medium or close-up shot. The studio keeps faces in frame and the camera out of walls and furniture.

Music and sound effects

Background music and effects are generated to length. The music dips under dialogue and the mix is levelled for YouTube.

Checks before you render

Unknown gestures, faces cut off, text outside the safe area: the checker flags them with the line number.

Fast pace when you want it

One switch for snappy cuts: tighter gaps, quicker voices and an automatic cut to whoever is speaking.

16:9, 9:16 or square

One line in the script picks the shape: landscape for YouTube, vertical for Shorts and Reels, square for feeds.

FAQ

Questions, answered

The short version: it is free, it runs on your computer, and nothing leaves your browser.

Do I need to install anything or sign up?

No. Open the studio in Chrome or Edge on a laptop or desktop, write a script and press Render. There is no account and nothing to install.

Is my script or my video uploaded anywhere?

No. The script, the voices and every frame are made inside your browser tab. The finished video stays in the tab until you download it.

How long does a render take?

It depends on your graphics chip. On an Apple M4 laptop a nine-second Full HD video takes about 25 seconds on a first visit, voice download included. Older laptops with basic graphics can be 5 to 20 times slower. Quick quality renders at half size and is much faster.

Why is the first render slower than the next ones?

The built-in voices download once, about 31 MB. Your browser keeps them, so later visits are ready in about a second.

Which browsers work?

Chrome and Edge are tested. Safari and Firefox can draw the frames, but their video encoders vary, so the page tells you if yours cannot save an MP4. The page needs HTTPS, which any normal hosting provides.

What happens if I close the tab while it renders?

The render stops. A finished video that you did not download is gone too, so save it before you leave the page.

Can I add my own characters or sets?

Not in the web version yet. It comes with Juno, Cloud, the Zopdev mascot, an office and a server room. You control everything they do from the script.
